    Your Event at Our World Class Venue,
    in the Heart of Leicester

    Mattioli Arena is the perfect venue for your corporate events regardless of size and shape.

    Whether you need an intimate meeting room to wine and dine clients, hold interviews,  run a training event for 5 to 500 people and change room layouts throughout the day, bring together colleagues from around the world virtually, or bring 3000 people together in person, we can accommodate your specific needs.

     

    • Individual rooms to suit meetings from 2 to 200 attendees.

    • A flexible layout of rooms for meetings, conferences, training events, which can change throughout the day for break outs, dining, and presentation size.

    • Digital screens in each room, air-conditioned throughout.

    • Two arenas with capacities up to 3000 with giant LED screens, high quality sound systems and tiered (grandstand) seating.

    • Leicester’s biggest, most flexible, conference and entertainment  venue.

    • Exclusive areas perfect for VIP offerings.

    ​

    Our Bespoke Event Building Package will ensure you have everything covered and guarantee success.

    Our experienced staff host events ranging from small meetings to internationally significant sports tournaments every week of the year, so they’re perfectly placed to help you build your unique event, to your specific requirements and to your individual budget.

     

    • In-house catering to design your unique menu, light refreshments, lunch or silver service dinner. Ensure all dietary requirements are catered for, local produce or tailored ingredients.

    • Layout design to ensure all attendees are engaged, your objectives are achieved and your event hits all the right notes.

    •  Fully licenced bar which can be set up in any of our spaces, meeting rooms to arenas.

    • In-house security and rigging teams mean we can quickly and effectively deliver any event.

    • On-line ticketing system to help you manage your bookings and ensure seamless access. 

    • Marketing support to raise your event’s profile to the widest audience and ensure it’s success.

    ​

    Room hire includes bespoke venue Layout, Digital Screen & Flipchart as well as catering pacakges available subject to event size/attendees.

    ​​

    To book your event call Lisa, our Event Manager now on 0116 326 9700 and start planning for a successful event today
